name: Emma Ytterell - Article 14, après le § 2 - Am 128
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: 2b. Member States may, through the competent national authority, classify projects within their territory as strategic on the basis of objective and published criteria if they are essential for food security or for maintaining agricultural production and processing capacities. Such designation shall be made by the Member State without prior approval or confirmation by the Commission. This may include, in particular, projects relating to primary agricultural production and livestock farming, the supply of feed and fertilisers, water storage and irrigation, as well as the storage, refrigeration, processing, and transport of agricultural products. Sections I, II, and III of the Annex shall also apply to those projects in accordance with the conditions set out therein. The application of the Annex pursuant to this paragraph requires neither a determination under paragraph 1 nor a reference under paragraph 2. The requirements set out in paragraphs 1 and 2 regarding a contribution to resilience and decarbonisation or to resource efficiency shall not apply in this context. When conducting the assessment pursuant to Section I of the Annex, the competent authority shall give special consideration to the project’s contribution to food security or to the maintenance of agricultural production and processing capacities and shall assess on a case-by-case basis whether the requirements of the directives specified therein are met.
